_doc: Hand-sorted (make, listed model, decoded model) pairs that share no word after the scan's normalization (scraper/junkyard_scraper.py _vpic_mismatch_msg). 'different': the VIN is another vehicle -> flagged 'VIN decodes as <Make> <Model> (listed <model>)'. 'same': another name for the same vehicle. 'unsure': not settled from the names and the decode fields; not flagged. 'decode_wrong': the VIN's own series/engine show the listing is right and vPIC's model name is wrong; not flagged. Keys compare lowercase letters and digits only. 'cars' = cars on the lots in the census.
